i<n ; i++){\n            vector<int>v = {dx[i] , dy[i] , dz[i]};\n            if(checkPythaTriplet(v)) count++;\n        }\n\n        return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"pythagorean-distance-nodes-in-a-tree","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1557}
